newsitem.title: CANADA: NHL ICE HOCKEY-CANUCKS AGREE TERMS WITH GOALIE IRBE.
newsitem.headline: NHL ICE HOCKEY-CANUCKS AGREE TERMS WITH GOALIE IRBE.

text.p: The Vancouver Canucks on Tuesday agreed to terms with Latvian free agent goaltender Arturs Irbe, who played last season with the Dallas Stars.

Irbe, 30, was 17-12-3 in 35 contests with the Stars last year. He had three shutouts, a 2.69 goals-against average and .893 save percentage. Irbe signed with Dallas as a free agent last August after five years with the San Jose Sharks.

The 1994 NHL All-Star enjoyed his best season that year, going 30-28-16 with a 2.84 goals-against average in 74 games. In 218 career NHL games, he owns a 74-103-29 record with 11 shutouts and a 3.35 GAA.
